title: Four Litres of Argument
subtitle: 生命科学 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 生命科学（科学与技术·生命科学）
meta: 主题语境：生命科学（科学与技术·生命科学）　|　核心词汇：blood　|　正文 338 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 blood 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1962 my mother was sent to read ① a blood sample she could not name, and she said the naming was the whole of the lesson. The ② blood, meaning the liquid and not the family, was four litres and was carried by whoever came last; a blood, she said, is the only thing in a hospital that is judged by how much has been taken out of it.

Every ③ blood test in that ward had the same number, and the ④ blood on the chart, meaning the reading and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever checked properly. A blood, my grandmother said, is nine parts water and one part somebody willing to stay behind; my mother said the water is the part that gets everywhere.

My father meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ blood was the whole of the family, meaning the lineage and not the liquid. The ⑥ blood, meaning the descent and not any of that, is the only thing in a house that everybody inherits and nobody questions; a blood, he said, is either something you test or the only word that means both a liquid and a family. She said the family is the part they remember.

By 1974 the ⑦ blood had become a number in a report, and the report had become an argument about the water. The ⑧ blood of the whole thing, my mother wrote in April, was four litres of liquid and eleven years of reading; a blood, she said, is either the reading on the chart or the reason you learned to stand on a chair. He said the chair was never mentioned.

The ⑨ blood I remember is the one on the chart, which was copied in 1979 and is still described as the best in the county. A ⑩ blood, my grandmother said in 1981, is the only thing that improves by being given; every blood, she said, is a family that has agreed to look like a liquid. She said the family was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 血液（指液体本身，与血统相对）
C. 固定搭配：read a blood sample 读一份血样
D. n. 血液（指病房里每一次检测）
E. n. 血（指化验单上的读数）
F. n. 血统；家族（抽象：与液体相对）
G. n. 血统（抽象：那件事本身）
H. n. 代价；整件事的分量（抽象总称）

items.q: a blood sample she could not name
The blood, meaning the liquid and not the family
Every blood test in that ward
blood was the whole of the family
the blood had become a number in a report
The blood of the whole thing
A blood, my grandmother said in 1981

answers.why: read a blood sample 意为“读一份血样”，1962 年母亲被派去读一份她叫不出名字的血样。
blood 意为“血液”，指液体本身而不是血统，共四升，由最后走的人拿着。
blood 指病房里每一次血检，每一次都是同一个数字。
blood 指化验单上的读数，是唯一有人认真核对过的。
blood 意为“血统、家族”，与液体相对，父亲说 blood 就是那个家族的全部。
blood 为抽象用法，指血统这件事本身，是屋子里人人都继承、却没人质疑的东西。
blood 意为“血、血液”，到 1974 年这个 blood 成了报告里的一个数字。
blood 意为“代价、整件事的分量”，母亲四月写道，整件事权衡下来是四升液体和十一年的读数。
blood 意为“血”，我记得的是化验单上那一份，1979 年被抄录，至今仍被说成全县最好的。
blood 为抽象总称，祖母说血液是唯一会因为被给予而变好的东西。
